description: Maryland weatherization helps income-eligible owners and renters with approved home energy improvements. A local weatherization agency handles intake and the energy assessment
introduction: Maryland weatherization helps income-eligible owners and renters with approved home energy improvements. A local weatherization agency handles intake and the energy assessment.

who: Household income rules apply, with recognized benefit programs providing categorical income eligibility.
The state lists SNAP, TANF, SSI, OHEP and HUD housing assistance among accepted pathways; Medicaid alone is not accepted as proof of automatic income eligibility.
sections.get: The assessment can identify air sealing, insulation, heating, hot-water, lighting and safety measures. The dwelling’s condition and program rules determine the approved work.
sections.docs: Prepare income records or qualifying-benefit proof and information about ownership, tenancy and utility use. Ask the local agency for its checklist and any landlord permission requirements.
sections.apply:
1. Use the local-agency directory on DHCD’s weatherization page.
  2. Submit the agency’s application; benefit participation does not remove this step.
  3. After eligibility review, arrange the energy inspection and discuss the recommended work.
sections.after: Ask about priorities and the waiting list. Confirm the approved scope and final inspection. If a property condition prevents work, ask what must be corrected and whether another repair program can help.
sections.sources:
• Maryland weatherization eligibility and agency directory
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots

faqs: Yes. Contact the local agency about the rental property and owner consent.
Does Medicaid automatically establish income eligibility?
No. Maryland’s WAP page specifically lists Medicaid among programs not accepted for automatic income eligibility.
Does receiving SNAP mean no application is needed?
No. It can establish income eligibility, but a weatherization application still must be submitted.
Can I choose every improvement on the state’s list?
No. An energy inspection and dwelling conditions determine appropriate approved measures.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
